objective: Add a credential-free public GitHub repository snapshot reader and a fail-closed exact-main, exact-head, named-CI evidence gate without granting mutation or merge authority.
acceptance: Only canonical https://api.github.com repository endpoints are read.
Every network request is GET with credentials omitted and redirects rejected.
Credential, header, endpoint and API-origin overrides are rejected.
The snapshot records exact default-branch SHA, PR head/base, divergence, mergeability and named check runs.
Missing, pending, failed, truncated or non-success required checks fail closed.
Moving main, moving PR head, draft/closed PR, wrong base, codex/* head, behind-main head, empty diff or unknown/non-mergeable state fail closed.
A passing gate remains evidence-only with merge_authorized=false and external_effect=false.
Exact-head Universal Exchange CI passes before merge.
